meta_description: What a party decor service does, what Porch & Party sets up around Memphis, from birthdays to porches, and how to ask for a quote for your date.
direct_answer: A party decor service is a team that brings the decorations to your party and sets them up for you. You tell us the date and the address. We bring everything for birthdays, showers, hotel room surprises, office parties, grazing tables and seasonal porches, and set it up before your guests arrive.

sections.heading: What a party decor service does
paragraphs: Decorating for a party takes longer than most people plan for. There is the shopping, the balloons, the table, the banner that will not hang straight, and then all the bags and boxes to clear away. A decor service takes that whole job off your list.

With Porch & Party, you send a request with your date, the address and the look you want. You can name your colors and a theme, or pick Freestyle and let us choose. On the day, our team arrives with every piece, sets up the room and leaves it ready for your guests.

We work in homes, hotel rooms and offices across the Memphis area, including Germantown, Collierville, Lakeland, Southaven and Olive Branch. In hotel rooms we use LED candles only, never an open flame.

sections.heading: Seasonal porch decorating
paragraphs: A front porch is the first thing your guests see. It is also a job a lot of people mean to do every season and never get around to.

Our seasonal porch decorating covers fall, Christmas and spring. We bring the pumpkins, wreaths, garland and planters, arrange them on your steps and around the door, and tidy up as we go. Christmas porches include the takedown in January, so the decor does not sit out until spring.
If you want a porch and a party on the same weekend, put both in one request and we will plan them together.
bullets: Fall porches with pumpkins and wreaths
Christmas porches with garland and wreaths
Spring porches for Easter, Mother's Day and graduations

sections.heading: Grazing tables and styled event decor
paragraphs: A grazing table is a spread of finger food laid out across a whole table, so guests can help themselves while they talk. It suits showers, office gatherings and small parties where a sit-down meal is more than you need.

We plan the menu with you, from everyday picks to premium cheeses, cured meats and specialty fruit. The food is quoted once your menu and head count are set, and the styling around the table is quoted on its own. We bring the food and the decor and set it all out before guests arrive.

Styled event decor covers the rest of the room around the food: the entry, a dessert table, or a sign with the guest of honor's name. Tell us which spaces you want dressed and we will plan around them.

sections.heading: Party game rentals, picked up at Mt. Moriah Station
paragraphs: Giant yard games give guests something to do between the food and the cake, and they work for kids and grown-ups alike.

Rentals work differently from our setups. You book the games online, pick them up at Mt. Moriah Station and bring them back there after the party. We do not deliver rentals. We ask every renter for a government photo ID, which keeps the games in good shape for the next party.
bullets: Picked up and returned at Mt. Moriah Station

sections.heading: How to get a quote
paragraphs: Use the quote button at the end of this page. Tell us your date, the address or venue, about how many guests you expect and the look you want. If the hotel is not booked yet, leave the location blank and add it later. We read every request and reply with an exact quote for your date.

Our team brings every piece of party decor directly to your home or office. You pick the date and the address, and our team handles all the heavy lifting and arrangement. faq.q: What does a party decor service include?
faq.a: It includes the decorations, the trip to your place and the setup. You give us the date, the address and the look you want. Our team brings the balloons, banners, table pieces or porch decor the job needs and sets everything up, so the room is ready when your guests walk in.

Yes. Hotel room setups for birthdays, anniversaries and surprises are a regular part of our work. We use LED candles only, never an open flame, and we usually set up in the afternoon around check-in. You can send the request before the room is booked and add the hotel later.

No. Party game rentals are picked up and returned at Mt. Moriah Station, and we do not deliver them. You book the games online, collect them before your party and bring them back afterward. Our decor setups are the other way around: for those, our team comes to you.

faq.q: How much does party decor cost?
faq.a: It depends on the size of the room, the look you want and the date. Send a quote request with those details and we will reply with an exact quote for your party. The quote button at the end of this page takes you straight to the request form.
